title: A graded user-intent corpus, run at start-up within a budget
goal: Author and version a ladder of real user intents from trivial to extreme, each with an independently checkable outcome and a cost and latency budget, and run a bounded slice of it after susi starts: a small number of intents, a spend ceiling and a wall-clock ceiling, with the full ladder available on demand and on a schedule. Every intent runs hermetically - throwaway workspace, scratch HOME, no live estate, no real egress - because an automatic run of extreme intents that touches the user's environment is a foot-gun, not a self-test. The result is a reproducible scorecard: per intent pass, fail or partial, what it cost, which worker ran it and where it stopped.
